key_insight: This review highlights how AI-assisted thermoreflectance imaging can help map nanoscale thermal properties and reveal heat transport shaped by interfaces and defects.
engineering_relevance: Improved local thermal characterization could support materials discovery, thermal management in miniaturized electronics, and advanced manufacturing.
method: Map thermal properties using non-contact pump–probe thermoreflectance imaging or scanning.
Apply AI-assisted processing to accelerate analysis and visualize interfacial thermal transport.
Explore nonintrusive subsurface characterization and future three-dimensional property mapping.
evidence_signal: The abstract summarizes recent advances but reports no datasets, quantitative accuracy metrics, or throughput benchmarks.
watch_item: Throughput–accuracy trade-offs and reliable extraction of multiple thermal parameters remain unresolved challenges.
paper_title: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
